summary.name: Seeking SRE
summary.one_liner: Seeking SRE is an O'Reilly book of conversations with engineers and leaders about running production systems at scale using Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.
use_cases: Learning how different teams implement SRE
Understanding how SRE relates to DevOps
Reading expert discussions on running production systems
Exploring the human and cultural side of SRE
Finding best practices and tools for SRE work
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a 590-page O'Reilly book, released September 2018, edited by David N. Blank-Edelman, that collects more than two dozen chapters of conversations with engineers and other leaders in the field. It covers different ways of implementing SRE in varied settings, how SRE relates to DevOps, emerging specialties, best practices and technologies that make SRE easier, and the human side of the discipline. The book is presented as a complement to Google's Site Reliability Engineering book, exploring a different part of the SRE space. The page lists purchase and online-reading options through O'Reilly Online Learning and Amazon.
notable: Edited by David N. Blank-Edelman as a collection of conversations rather than a single author's guide
More than two dozen chapters covering SRE in varied settings
Companion to Google's Site Reliability Engineering book, covering a different part of the SRE space
Covers the human side of SRE alongside technical practices
caveats: Reading the book on O'Reilly Online Learning requires a trial or subscription; the page offers a 10-day trial
Purchasing print or ebook copies is directed to Amazon or other retailers
Page does not state the price of the book
